title: POV: Walking Hong Kong's Tram Line — Running Since 1904 | China Travel Expert
description:
POV: you're walking Hong Kong's tram line, dodging a "Ding Ding" on Hong Kong Island. These double-decker trams have rattled along the north shore since 1904, and the system is the world's largest fleet of double-deck trams still in daily service — about 165 cars, carrying a couple of hundred thousand riders a day.

Locals nicknamed them "Ding Dings" after the bell the drivers ring. For a couple of Hong Kong dollars you get the slowest, most scenic ride in the city — the whole street at eye level.

★ Expert Tip: board at the back, pay a flat fare when you get off, and climb to the very front seat on the upper deck — it's the best free "tour" of Hong Kong Island you'll find.

POV：走香港电车线。叮叮车自 1904 年就在港岛跑，是全球还在日常营运的最大双层电车队（约 165 辆）。本地人叫它"叮叮"，因为司机按铃的声音。你会坐上层，还是沿路走？
